case.title: TRAINING ONLY / Does an announcement establish an outcome?

records.title: TRAINING / Assessment, alternatives and next evidence
records.body:
Question: does this announcement establish a completed facility?

Evidence: the fictional notice records a proposal and explicitly leaves milestones unconfirmed.

Judgment: this document alone is insufficient to establish implementation.

Assumption: the stored notice is complete. If it is only an extract, omitted passages may matter.

Alternative: funding and work may be recorded in another document. Lack of confirmation is not proof of absence.

Contrary evidence to seek: a dated budget decision, work record or independently sourced opening report.

What would change the assessment: attributable records establishing the relevant milestone.

TRAINING ONLY. This is a worked reasoning example, not an assessment of a real place.
